notes: Intros made via conference follow-up (MoneyTech 2024). AE: Maya Patel. SE: Connor Hayes.
Initial use-case: reduce chargeback false positives via reranking + embeddings for historical patterns. Also live-chat augmentation for 24/7 ops.
Requirements summary: sub-100ms 95th percentile latency for chat, peak throughput 120 reqs/s across geos, strict PII handling and EU residency for a portion of payments telemetry.
Security: asked for SOC2 attestation, SSO (SAML) integration, KMS-managed keys, 3 year audit log retention. Wanted private deployment (VPC) or on-prem option for EU ledger workloads.

Timeline highlights: demo completed 2024-12-12 (runtime perf + cost talk). Security questionnaire submitted 2025-01-16. POC requested for core reranker on dedicated GPUs; Redwood dedicated recommended.

Sponsor: Head of ML, Marcus Lee. Strong champion initially — drove procurement fast. Quote from Marcus on 2025-02-11: 'If we can hit the 85% reduction in false positives in POC we can move to handoff.'
Turning point: 2025-03 reorg — Marcus promoted out of payments group into a product role; new payments VP deprioritized ML spend; procurement put on hold pending Q3 budgeting.

Competitor: Aureline evaluated StratusAI (vendor) in parallel — Stratus committed to an accelerated commercial pilot with pre-packed compliance paperwork and a custom pricing concession. Aureline chose Stratus pilot on 2025-04-02.
Final state: procurement paused, internal champion gone, procurement champion not replaced. AE notes: 'Closed-lost for now — mark churned due to internal reorg; keep warm for Q3 re-eval.'

Follow-ups: attempted reconnect 2025-04-10 after exec call; response from procurement lead: 'we appreciate Redwood's tech but priorities shifted, pausing all vendor contracts; will revisit in Q3 if headcount/budget returns.'
Stubs/Artifacts: pricing deck in Drive, security questionnaire snapshot, Fireflies transcript of 2025-03-12 exec call.

Suggested playbook: add to 90-day nurture cadence, tailor outreach to new payments VP with competitive differentiation vs Stratus (privacy + SLA), prepare condensed compliance packet and a two-week sandbox offer.
